mapper.select: SELECT lectures.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(day_of_week, start_period, '-', end_period) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, lectures.capacity, semesters.academic_year, semesters.term FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN users ON lectures.professor_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC
